read_res <- function(path) {
  x <- readRDS(path)
  data.frame(
    gene = attr(x, \"rownames\"),
    baseMean = x@listData"'$baseMean,
    log2FoldChange = x@listData$log2FoldChange,
    lfcSE = x@listData$lfcSE,
    stat = x@listData$stat,
    pvalue = x@listData$pvalue,
    padj = x@listData$padj,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

link_lines <- readLines("https://rest.kegg.jp/link/pathway/pau", warn = FALSE)
links <- do.call(rbind, strsplit(link_lines, "'"\\t\", fixed = TRUE))
map <- data.frame(gene = sub(\""'^pau:", "", links[,1]), pathway = sub("''^path:", "", links[,2]), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

ora <- function(res, minGSSize = 1L, maxGSSize = Inf, universe_mode = c("tested_mapped", "kegg_all")) {
  universe_mode <- match.arg(universe_mode)
  fg <- res$gene[!is.na(res$padj) & abs(res$log2FoldChange) > 1.5 & res$padj < 0.05]
  if (universe_mode == "tested_mapped") {
    universe <- intersect(res$gene, unique(map$gene))
  } else {
    universe <- unique(map$gene)
  }
  fg <- intersect(fg, universe)
  m2 <- map[map$gene %in% universe, ]
  gs <- split(unique(m2$gene), m2$pathway)
  gs <- gs[lengths(gs) >= minGSSize & lengths(gs) <= maxGSSize]
  hits <- vapply(gs, function(g) sum(g %in% fg), integer(1))
  gs <- gs[hits > 0]
  hits <- hits[hits > 0]
  M <- length(universe)
  N <- length(fg)
  K <- lengths(gs)
  p <- phyper(hits - 1, K, M - K, N, lower.tail = FALSE)
  padj <- p.adjust(p, method = "BH")
  out <- data.frame(pathway = names(gs), k = hits, K = K, N = N, M = M, pvalue = p, padj = padj, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  out[order(out$padj, out$pvalue, out$pathway), ]
}

glu <- read_res("inputs/res_GluFevsGluFePlus.rds")
succ <- read_res("inputs/res_SuccvsGluFePlus.rds")

cat(\"mapped tested\", length(intersect(glu"'$gene, unique(map$gene))), length(intersect(succ$gene, unique(map$gene))), "'"\\n\")

    sg <- eg"'$pathway[eg$padj < 0.05]
    ss <- es$pathway[es$padj < 0.05]
    ans <- setdiff(sg, ss)
    cat("MODE", mode, "FILTER", minmax, "sig_glu", length(sg), "sig_succ", length(ss), "setdiff", length(ans), "'"\\n\")
    cat(\"only_glu\", paste(ans, collapse=\",\"), \"\\n\")
    cat(\"sig_glu\", paste(sg, collapse=\",\"), \"\\n\")

read_res <- function(path) {
  x <- readRDS(path)
  data.frame(
    gene = attr(x, \"rownames\"),
    log2FoldChange = x@listData"'$log2FoldChange,
    padj = x@listData$padj,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}
link_lines <- readLines("https://rest.kegg.jp/link/pathway/pau", warn = FALSE)
links <- do.call(rbind, strsplit(link_lines, "'"\\t\", fixed = TRUE))
map <- unique(data.frame(gene = sub(\""'^pau:", "", links[,1]), pathway = sub("''^path:", "", links[,2]), stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
ora <- function(res, minGSSize = 1L, maxGSSize = Inf, universe_mode = c("tested_mapped", "kegg_all"), include_zero = FALSE) {
  universe_mode <- match.arg(universe_mode)
  fg0 <- res$gene[!is.na(res$padj) & abs(res$log2FoldChange) > 1.5 & res$padj < 0.05]
  universe <- if (universe_mode == "tested_mapped") intersect(res$gene, unique(map$gene)) else unique(map$gene)
  fg <- intersect(fg0, universe)
  m2 <- map[map$gene %in% universe, ]
  gs <- lapply(split(m2$gene, m2$pathway), unique)
  gs <- gs[lengths(gs) >= minGSSize & lengths(gs) <= maxGSSize]
  hits <- vapply(gs, function(g) sum(g %in% fg), integer(1))
  if (!include_zero) {
    gs <- gs[hits > 0]
    hits <- hits[hits > 0]
  }
  M <- length(unique(universe)); N <- length(unique(fg)); K <- lengths(gs)
  p <- phyper(hits - 1, K, M - K, N, lower.tail = FALSE)
  # For zero-hit terms, phyper(-1,...) gives 1 as desired.
  p[hits == 0] <- 1
  padj <- p.adjust(p, method = "BH")
  data.frame(pathway = names(gs), k = hits, K = K, N = N, M = M, pvalue = p, padj = padj, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)[order(padj, p, names(gs)), ]
}

succ <- read_res("inputs/res_SuccvsGluFePlus.rds")

cat(\"mapped tested\", length(intersect(glu"'$gene, unique(map$gene))), length(intersect(succ$gene, unique(map$gene))), "'"\\n\")
for (mode in c(\"tested_mapped\", \"kegg_all\")) {
  for (minmax in c(\"all\", \"cp\")) {
    for (zero in c(FALSE, TRUE)) {

/bin/bash -lc "Rscript - <<'RS'
read_res <- function(path) {
  x <- readRDS(path)
  data.frame(gene=attr(x,\"rownames\"), log2FoldChange=x@listData"'$log2FoldChange, padj=x@listData$padj, stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
}
link_lines <- readLines("https://rest.kegg.jp/link/pathway/pau", warn=FALSE)
links <- do.call(rbind, strsplit(link_lines, "'"\\t\", fixed=TRUE))
map <- unique(data.frame(gene=sub(\""'^pau:", "", links[,1]), pathway=sub("''^path:", "", links[,2]), stringsAsFactors=FALSE))
ora_sig <- function(res) {
  foreground <- res$gene[!is.na(res$padj) & abs(res$log2FoldChange) > 1.5 & res$padj < 0.05]
  universe <- intersect(res$gene, unique(map$gene))
  foreground <- intersect(foreground, universe)
  gs <- lapply(split(map$gene[map$gene %in% universe], map$pathway[map$gene %in% universe]), unique)
  hits <- vapply(gs, function(g) sum(g %in% foreground), integer(1))
  gs <- gs[hits > 0]
  hits <- hits[hits > 0]
  M <- length(universe); N <- length(foreground); K <- lengths(gs)
  p <- phyper(hits - 1, K, M - K, N, lower.tail=FALSE)
  padj <- p.adjust(p, method="BH")
  names(padj)[padj < 0.05]
}
glu_sig <- ora_sig(read_res("inputs/res_GluFevsGluFePlus.rds"))
succ_sig <- ora_sig(read_res("inputs/res_SuccvsGluFePlus.rds"))
answer <- length(setdiff(glu_sig, succ_sig))
dir.create("codex_output", showWarnings=FALSE)
writeLines(as.character(answer), "codex_output/answer.txt")
cat(answer, "'"\\n\")
cat(paste(sort(setdiff(glu_sig, succ_sig)), collapse=\",\"), \"\\n\")
RS
